title: qr-graph impact line
description: One URI the invalidation reaches through the declared graph, breadth-first, each reached once by its shortest path. Follow `by` back to the start to explain the line.

via.description: `target`: the URI asked about. `refresh`/`purge`: a target of the write method asked about. `collection`: a list the #[Link(rel: 'collection')] on the written resource's onGet() names, purged by the write. `embed`: embeds `by`, by an #[Embed] or by its resource layout. `dependsOn`: its onGet() declares #[DependsOn] on `by`; followed only from a `target`, `refresh`, `purge` or `collection` line, since the declaration carries the exact tag of `by` and nothing `by` carries. Tags are not compared: a declaration that does not match what the write purges is warned on stderr and still listed.

cached.description: Whether the resource declares a cache at all. Tags reach a parent only from a child that already ran, carrying an ETag (the non-donut path), or an ETag or Surrogate-Key (donut materials; holes have not run yet), so an `embed` line whose `by` is not cached is a dependency the cache may not track (for a donut page, a hole rendered per request). A `by` reached via `dependsOn` is the exception: once it has run inside the page (not as a hole), its declared tags reach the page whether it is cached or not.

source.description: file:line; null for a URI no scanned resource serves.
